mapper.sql: select d.ID, d.parent_id, d.ancestors, d.dept_name, d.order_num, d.leader, d.phone, d.email, d.status, d.YN, d.CREATE_USER, d.CREATE_TIME from sys_dept d
mapper.select: select concat(d.ID, d.dept_name) as dept_name from sys_dept d left join sys_role_dept rd on d.ID = rd.dept_id where d.YN = '1' and rd.role_id = #{roleId} order by d.parent_id, d.order_num
select count(1) from sys_user where dept_id = #{deptId} and YN = '1'
where dept_name=#{deptName} and parent_id = #{parentId} and YN = '1' limit 1

select d.ID, d.parent_id, d.ancestors, d.dept_name, d.order_num, d.leader, d.phone, d.email, d.status, (select dept_name from sys_dept where ID = d.parent_id) parent_name from sys_dept d where d.ID = #{id}
select * from sys_dept where find_in_set(#{id}, ancestors)
select count(*) from sys_dept where status = 0 and YN = '1' and find_in_set(#{id}, ancestors)
mapper.insert: insert into sys_dept( ID, parent_id, dept_name, ancestors, order_num, leader, phone, email, status, CREATE_USER, CREATE_USER_NICKNAME, CREATE_TIME )values( #{id}, #{parentId}, #{deptName}, #{ancestors}, #{orderNum}, #{leader}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{status}, #{createUser}, #{createUserNickname}, sysdate() )
mapper.delete: update sys_dept set YN = '0' where ID = #{id}
mapper.update:
